name: 垂直居住巨构

parameters.prompt: Create the complete isolated object from the reference. Preserve the proportions and architectural silhouette, complete front sides and back, watertight solid forms, flat attachment base. No ground, background, characters, baked lighting or floating effects. A slender immense residential megabuilding, height nine times width, stacked apartment blocks, irregular inset balconies, exposed service pipes, orange apartment windows, central open mechanical belt, rooftop antenna cluster.

imageProvider: project configured OpenAI-compatible gpt-image-2 via bundled imagegen CLI
adoption: adopted after front, side and rear inspection; runtime architecture floor assembly preserves window proportions

optimization.geometry: gltf-transform 4.5.1 simplify ratio 0.4 error 0.005; original and scene-detail retained

runtimeAssembly: Architectural core floor bands clipped and repeated to design height without stretching windows; vehicle meshes remain single models
